long_biography.plain_text:
Kushner Companies began as a New Jersey property business founded by Charles Kushner in 1985. Jared Corey Kushner joined that established family platform, became chief executive in his twenties and helped move its focus towards Manhattan office, retail and residential assets. He later stepped away from day-to-day leadership but retained a minority interest in the multigenerational company.

In 2021 Kushner created Affinity Partners, a Miami-based investment manager that advises private funds. As founder and chief executive, he controls Affinity's general-partner entities and directs investment decisions. His control lies in the management and general-partner businesses; portfolio securities held by Affinity funds are not his direct personal property.
long_biography.html:
Kushner Companies began as a New Jersey property business founded by Charles Kushner in 1985. Jared Corey Kushner joined that established family platform, became chief executive in his twenties and helped move its focus towards Manhattan office, retail and residential assets. He later stepped away from day-to-day leadership but retained a minority interest in the multigenerational company.

In 2021 Kushner created Affinity Partners, a Miami-based investment manager that advises private funds. As founder and chief executive, he controls Affinity's general-partner entities and directs investment decisions. His control lies in the management and general-partner businesses; portfolio securities held by Affinity funds are not his direct personal property.
